description: A harness that is somebody else's: hands a task, whole, to an agent from outside — one the configuration names — at work in the run's workspace where it has one, or in the project, and says what the agent said and how its turn ended.

parameters.task?: string: what is to be done — where none is given, the project's own prompt
parameters.agent: string: the agent that does the work, by its name in the configuration ("agents" in config.json) — said once in this project's own arguments, it is the agent of every run
parameters.model?: string: a model, for an agent that has none of its own: the agent's own serves otherwise
parameters.system?: string: standing instructions for the work, on top of the agent's own
parameters.seconds?: number: how long the agent may take (600)

returns.summary?: string: the agent's answer — the last of what it said; absent where it said nothing
returns.ok: boolean: whether its turn ended as one does
returns.stopReason?: string: how the turn ended — end_turn, max_tokens, max_turn_requests, refusal, cancelled
returns.session?: string: the id of the conversation, as the agent has it
returns.usage?: json: what the agent said it used — its own account, not counted by trama

input.prompt: Say what is to be done: trama run <this project> --arg task="…"
